{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm response rate is based on 'responded' column
total_per_site = data.groupby('site').size()
responded_per_site = data.groupby('site')['responded'].sum()
response_rate_per_site = (responded_per_site / total_per_site) * 100

# Sort by response rate descending
response_rate_per_site_sorted = response_rate_per_site.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Print results
response_rate_per_site_sorted"}
